Olivia Grant: flagging ticket#81220 from Nimbus — their June invoice omitted the committed instance discount and later a second invoice arrived with a zero subtotal but a payment token shown in the email. cc @Samir
Samir Kaur: thanks. invoice ids?
Olivia Grant: inv_20260630_nimbus_primary and inv_20260630_nimbus_retry
Ben Holt: customer timeline: primary sent at 2026-06-30T23:58 local, retry at 2026-07-01T00:02. They were charged the correct amount but scared by the second email showing a token snippet.
Rachel Park: pulling logs now. looks like billing-run hit a boundary condition when the account had a manual timezone offset set (+12:45) — rare but supported. conversion math truncated offsets which pushed commitments out of window and left invoice empty.
Samir Kaur: that's nasty. do we have log excerpt?
Ben Holt: ```INFO 2026-06-30T11:59:59Z billing: start acct=nimbus id=acct_614 window_end_local=2026-06-30T23:59:59+12:45
INFO 2026-06-30T11:59:59Z billing: convert window_end_local -> window_end_utc=2026-06-30T11:14:14Z (truncated seconds)
WARN 2026-06-30T11:59:59Z billing: proration removed commitments for acct_614 due to window mismatch
ERROR 2026-06-30T11:59:59Z billing: invoice-empty after proration -> RetryableInvoiceError
INFO 2026-06-30T11:59:59Z billing: retry_count=1 triggered for invoice_key=2026-06-30-acct_614```
Olivia Grant: and the retry path created inv_..._retry with zero lines but the email renderer still attached a temporary payment reference: `pay_ref: pay_tok_***_b7c`. the pdf redaction ran on the original pipeline but not reliably on retries.
Rachel Park: propose immediate steps: 1) suspend outgoing invoice emails for the invoice_key until stability confirmed; 2) regenerate invoice using fixed timezone conversion logic (branch: fix/tz-truncation-leap); 3) issue a credit note / customer-facing apology explaining only one real charge occurred; 4) add an audit entry and purge the partial token from logs and email archives.
Samir Kaur: finance ok with credits and customer note. keep wording conservative re: "internal process error" and loop in legal if token exposure included any identifiable payment method.
Ben Holt: I'll run a dry-run on the fix branch and paste the preview (tokenized IDs only).
Ben Holt: dry-run preview: ```invoice_preview: {account: acct_614, period: 2026-06-01..2026-06-30, lines: [reserved-instance: $2,400.00, overage: $45.60], total: $2,445.60}``` looks correct.
Olivia Grant: thanks. Samir please prepare the customer email + credit note and include the proration delta table. Rachel please reopen retention job to scrub the partial pay token and add an incident tag.
BillingBot: automated: created task TASK-10888 assigned to @Rachel Park for scrubbing artifacts; monitoring enabled for acct_614 for 96h for zero-line or duplicate invoice events.
Samir Kaur: I'll draft the email and confirm with legal. also adding a billing-run integration test to cover non-hourly timezone offsets (+12:45, +5:45, etc.).
Olivia Grant: add postmortem item: ensure retry path runs the same redaction and email pipeline as the primary path and never publishes partial payment tokens. follow-up in retro next week. :white_check_mark:
BillingBot: monitoring active for acct_614, alerts will post to #finance and #eng-billing for 96 hours.
